It’s time for Mat to review the all-new BMW iX3!

It’s the first car to be built on BMW’s dedicated ‘Neue Klasse’ EV platform, but to see if this entry-level electric SUV has the soul of a real BMW, Mat’s doing something a bit different: he’s comparing it to a 6-year-old BMW X3 M! 

Can the silent, high-tech newcomer actually hold a candle to the twin-turbo petrol beast of yesteryear?

The iX3 marks a radical departure from the BMWs we’ve reviewed in the past. It features the new "Neue Klasse" design language, so gone are the massive vertical "buck-tooth" grilles, replaced by a wider, horizontal kidney grille that merges into the headlights. The silhouette is sleek (but if anything, a little bland), and it features flush-fitting door handles and a clean, minimalist rear end with wrap-around L-shaped light bars. It’s certainly modern, but will Mat prefer this all-new design over the X3 M?
